content.title: 98th Oscars® Music (Original Song) Nominees: Stream the Nominated Songs
content.text: Five songs across five films have been nominated in the category of Music (Original Song) at the 98th Oscars®, and you can stream each of them using the links below. For even more about the Oscars, hosted by Conan O'Brien, you can view the full list of 98th Oscars nominees, participate in the Oscars Pick 'Em Game, download your printable Oscars ballot, and catch up on all of the latest Oscars news, including presenters and performers announcements, right here on Oscars.com! "Dear Me" from DIANE WARREN: RELENTLESS Music and Lyric by Diane Warren Stream it on: Amazon Music | Apple Music | Spotify | YouTube Music | Music Video "Golden" from KPOP DEMON HUNTERS Music and Lyric by EJAE, Mark Sonnenblick, Joong Gyu Kwak, Yu Han Lee, Hee Dong Nam, Jeong Hoon Seo and Teddy Park Stream it on: Amazon Music | Apple Music | Spotify | YouTube Music | Music Video "I Lied To You" from SINNERS Music and Lyric by Raphael Saadiq and Ludwig Goransson Stream it on: Amazon Music | Apple Music | Spotify | YouTube Music | Music Video "Sweet Dreams Of Joy" from VIVA VERDI! Music and Lyric by Nicholas Pike Stream it on: Amazon Music | Apple Music | Spotify | YouTube Music | Music Video "Train Dreams" from TRAIN DREAMS Music by Nick Cave and Bryce Dessner; Lyric by Nick Cave Stream it on: Amazon Music | Apple Music | Spotify | YouTube Music | Music Video The 98th Oscars will be held on Sunday, March 15, 2026, at the Dolby® Theatre at Ovation Hollywood and will be televised live on ABC, streamed live on Hulu and airs live in more than 200 territories worldwide.
